name: How do I choose the right custom home builder for my project?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right custom home builder for my project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Selecting the right builder involves researching their experience, portfolio of past projects, and reputation. Look for builders who specialize in custom homes and have experience with styles similar to what you envision. Check references from previous clients and verify their licensing and insurance. A good builder should demonstrate clear communication, transparency in pricing, and a strong understanding of local building codes. It's also important to feel comfortable with their team and their approach to project management.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a builder based on experience, portfolio, client references, licensing, insurance, and clear communication. Ensure they understand your vision and local codes.
